title: Kindness Matters: Evaluating the Impact of a Classroom Kindness Intervention
official: Kindness Matters: Evaluating the Impact of a Classroom Kindness Intervention on Teacher and Student Well-being, Social Emotional, Stress Physiology, and Classroom Ecology
summary:
The goal of this clinical trial is to examine how a brief, classroom-based kindness intervention affects students' and teachers' well-being and classroom ecology. The main questions this study aims to answer are:

1. Does participation in the kindness intervention improve teachers' psychological well-being, social and emotional competence, classroom-related functioning, and physiological stress regulation?
2. Does participation in the kindness intervention improve students' psychological well-being, social and emotional competence, classroom functioning, and physiological stress regulation?
3. Does the kindness intervention positively influence classroom ecology (e.g., classroom climate, relationships, and prosocial interactions)?
4. Does the kindness intervention produce contagion effects within classrooms (i.e., does kindness spread from teachers to students and among peers)?

Researchers will compare an active control group with two experimental groups: one in which only teachers participate in the kindness intervention and another in which both teachers and students participate independently in the kindness intervention. These comparisons will examine whether implementing the kindness intervention with both teachers and students produces greater improvements in well-being and classroom ecology than implementing the intervention with teachers alone or participating in an active control condition.

Participants assigned to the kindness intervention will be asked to perform three distinct acts of kindness toward others on one day per week for four weeks. Participants assigned to the active control group will be asked to count their daily activities on one day per week for four weeks.

interventions.name: Kindness Intervention for Teachers and Students

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 5th and 6th grade teachers (minimum .5 full time equivalent)
* 5th and 6th grade students

Exclusion Criteria:

* Part-time teachers (less than .5 full time equivalent)
* Substitute teachers
* School counselors
* School administrators
* Other school staff
